basic_info.description: Welcome to 2314 43rd Avenue, a beautifully well maintained single-family home nestled in San Francisco desirable Outer Parkside neighborhood. This inviting 2-beds, 1-bath residence seamlessly blends classic charm with contemporary enhancements, offering a comfortable and stylish living experience. Step inside to discover a thoughtfully remodeled kitchen, boasting modern finishes and appliances that cater to both everyday living and entertaining. The refreshed hardwood floors add warmth & elegance throughout the living spaces, while the newly applied interior & exterior paint provide a fresh, clean aesthetic. Located just blocks from the scenic Ocean Beach & the vibrant Taraval Street corridor, this home offers easy access to local cafes, shops, & public transportation. The Outer Parkside area is renowned for its laid-back atmosphere, coastal beauty, & strong community spirit. Recent developments, such as the transformation of a portion of the Great Highway into a pedestrian-friendly park, are enhancing the neighborhood's appeal & are expected to positively influence property values . Don't miss the opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in one of San Francisco most up-and-coming neighborhoods. Experience the perfect blend of tranquility & urban convenience at 2314 43rd Avenue.
